props.name: tabs
props.note: Each tab: label, icon, selectedIcon. React tabs can also take href (a link); Flutter tabs can take child (replaces the icon).

props.name: landmarkLabel
props.why: The web bar is a nav landmark and needs a name; Flutter has no landmarks, each tab reads "Tab n of m".

props.name: solid
props.why: On the web, solid surfaces follow setAurumPreferences({ transparency }).
